## Research Interests

Operations research, optimization, and machine learning — in particular, algorithms
for autonomous decision-making in inventory, manufacturing, and supply chain
systems. Current work covers data-driven optimization for multi-echelon supply
chains under uncertainty, optimization for robotic manufacturing systems, and
reinforcement learning with an emphasis on explainability and human-centric,
trustworthy decision support.
